sloka: एवमुक्तम् तदा रक्षो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ।रावणस्य बलम् सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ॥६-१९-८॥।।
transliteration: evamuktam tadā rakṣo rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ।rāvaṇasya balam sarvamākhyātumupacakrame ॥6-19-8॥।।

translations.english: "That which has been spoken by the Lord of monkeys in this way is not possible for one who has not studied sastras or served the elders."
